A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same CUSP research and contain 27 readable pages, including the complete appendix. Text and rendered-page comparisons support reliable matching of methods, equations, results, figures, and tables.

before.justification: v1 reports original node-classification and link-prediction experiments across eight datasets, including baseline comparisons in Tables 3 and 8 and ablations in Tables 6 and 9.

after.justification: v2 retains the original node-classification and link-prediction results, component ablations, and manifold-signature experiments in the main text and appendix.

M1.justification: The Cusp Laplacian, mixed-curvature filtering, functional curvature encoding, and pooling procedures in Section 4 are identical. Appendix Algorithm 1 for manifold-signature estimation is also unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate node classification and link prediction on Cora, Citeseer, PubMed, Chameleon, Actor, Squirrel, Texas, and Cornell. No dataset, domain, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Tables 3 and 8 retain the same comparators: GCN, GAT, SAGE, HGCN, HGAT, κGCN, QGCN, SelfMGNN, ChebyNet, BernNet, GPRGNN, and FiGURe. Their participation in both task comparisons is unchanged.

E3.justification: Section 5 retains the 60%/20%/20% node-classification split, 85%/5%/10% link-prediction split, F1 and AUC-ROC metrics, manifold dimension 48, and filter setting L=10. Appendix Table 13 retains the same hyperparameter configurations.

E4.justification: The manifold-signature comparisons, learned filter/manifold-weight analyses, and ablations of geometry, Laplacian, encoding, pooling, and filter bank are unchanged. This includes the appendix link-prediction analyses in Tables 9–12.

E5.justification: Both versions report averaging over 10 random splits with 95% confidence intervals. No repeated-run information or uncertainty-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: All numerical results and plotted findings are unchanged, including appendix results. For example, both report CUSP Cora F1 of 83.45 ± 0.15 in Table 3 and Cora link-prediction AUC of 95.08 ± 0.13 in Table 8.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, assumptions, derivations, and proofs in Sections 3–4 and Appendices 7.2–7.5 are identical, including the Cusp Laplacian properties and curvature-kernel translation-invariance argument.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same spectral–geometric unification claim, three principal CUSP components, and performance-superiority claims. The added code-availability sentence does not revise the scientific contributions.

C2.justification: Interpretations of spectral preferences, manifold mismatch, and component ablations remain unchanged. Appendix 7.6.4 retains the qualification that the signature-estimation heuristic does not guarantee an optimal manifold combination.

D1.justification: v2 adds a code-availability statement and a direct link to the amazon-science/cusp repository in the abstract; v1 provides no CUSP repository pointer. Existing implementation details and appendix hyperparameter information remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, novelty positioning, and cited-work set are unchanged. Bibliographic entries merely reflow across pages 11–13 after insertion of the acknowledgement.

P1.justification: v2 appends one code-availability sentence to the abstract and adds an Acknowledgements section thanking Geoffrey J. Gordon before the references. The scientific prose and section organization otherwise remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The additions cause limited text and page-layout shifts on pages 1–2 and 11–13, alongside the updated arXiv stamp. Figures, tables, captions, and appendix layouts are unchanged.

improvement.justification: The new implementation-repository pointer modestly improves reproducibility documentation by giving readers access information absent from v1. The scientific content and appendices are unchanged, while the acknowledgement and reflow have little quality impact. The PDFs establish the added pointer, but not the repository's contents or usability.
